question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

My strength is as the strenght of ten because my heart is pure.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"strenght"** is a misspelling of the word **"strength"**.

 
 
• **Meaning:** The capacity of an object or substance to withstand great force or pressure; also refers to the quality or state of being strong. (ताकत)
 
• **Example:** His** strength** allowed him to lift the heavy weights effortlessly.
 
 
 
• **"Strength"** is the correct spelling. (ताकत)
 
 
• **Example:** She showed great **strength** in overcoming her challenges.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: my heart is pure** (मेरा दिल शुद्ध है)

 
 
• **Example:** She believes that her heart is pure and full of love.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: My strength is** (मेरी ताकत है)
 
 
• **Example:** My strength is derived from my daily workouts.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: of ten because** (दस का क्योंकि)
 
 
• **Example:** The strength of ten because of his rigorous training.
 
 

51:Tb8d,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**</p
